specification:
Type: Interactive simulation **sim-id:** performance-metrics-explorer
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified **Purpose:** Visualize the relationships between latency, throughput, response time, and concurrency using Little's Law. Users manipulate arrival rate and service time sliders to see how all metrics change. **Controls:** - Arrival Rate slider (requests/second): 10–1000 - Service Time slider (ms): 1–500 - Concurrency Limit slider: 1–100 **Display panels:** - Live Little's Law calculation showing L, λ, W - Latency distribution histogram (p50/p95/p99 markers) - Throughput gauge - Queue depth indicator **Behavior:** When arrival rate × service time > concurrency limit, the queue grows visually and p99 latency spikes dramatically — illustrating queue saturation.
